candidates.change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll transfers no funds.
Replace the withdrawn amount address(this).balance with depositsCount, changing how much is transferred (and possibly reverting).
Remove the require check in onlyOwner so any caller can execute withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Invert the ownership check in the onlyOwner modifier so authorized calls revert and unauthorized calls proceed.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint) so any address may call it.
Transfer the contract's entire balance instead of the requested _value amount.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw completes without moving any Ether.
Remove the revert-on-failure check so failed low-level calls no longer revert the transaction.
Send empty calldata instead of _data so the target's fallback runs instead of the intended function.
Remove the ownership requirement from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call sendMoney.
